PLAN "12-Week General Strength Programme for Desk Worker with Prior L5-S1 Disc Herniation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with spine-friendly movements and progressive overload while avoiding heavy spinal load and loaded spinal flexion"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and Tissue-loading Base":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_extension 5m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Posterior Chain & Scapular Health":
        warmup:
          shoulder_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Horizontal Push/Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          plank 3x30s

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progressive Overload Upper/Lower Alternating":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_thrust 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Posterior Chain Emphasis":
        warmup:
          light_rowing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_extension 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Body Stability & Load Management":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hollow_hold 3x20s

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Strength & Control Density":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          plank 3x45s
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility & Core Stabilization":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull with Reduced Spinal Load":
        warmup:
          jogging 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_extension 5m

  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak Strength with Safe Loading":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hollow_hold 3x30s
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Stability & Mobility":
        warmup:
          shoulder_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension 2m
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Conditioning & Accessory Focus":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_calf_raise 5m
